title: group_list_members — input
description: Input schema for the SOX group_list_members operation. Returns the current membership table for a group. The calling agent MUST be an active member. Optionally annotates each member with their current presence state from sox/presence. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.5.

group_id.description: The full group channel name including the 'group/' prefix (e.g. 'group/eng-team').

include_presence.description: When true, annotate each member with their current presence state read from sox/presence. When false (default), presence_state is null on all member records.
